source_segments.text: to the state of Bangantha and Samatat .
After the deaths of King Shashanka and Shashanka of Gaur in the 7th century , it was ruled by Emperor Harshavardhana .
During the period 725-735 AD , when the king of Kanaujar Yashovardhana conquered the kingdoms of Gaur and Bengal , the whole of Bengal , including Jhenaidah , came under his rule .
From 781-821 AD , Jhenaidah belonged to the Pala dynasty .
After the fall of the Paul dynasty , the Burmese ruled the Jhenaidah region from 1080-1150 AD .
